title: Cleanup script in a later release inherits no DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT
expected_feedback: Critical: DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT is a session setting, and phase 2 ships as a separate release running in a different session — the value set in phase 1 does not carry over. Read as a single file the plan looks protected; deployed as two releases the cleanup runs with the default of 0 (NOWAIT) and fails with ORA-00054 the moment any session holds a transient lock on ORDERS. Re-set DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT at the top of every migration file rather than once at the top of the plan. Note also that SET UNUSED is irreversible, so phase 2 needs a restore/PITR classification.
violated_rule: DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT set before every DDL session
